gaps_named_for_handoff: G1 daily bars store no available_time and no traded value. The switched evaluator derives ts as trade date 14:30 +08:00 (the rule the old read applies to date-only rows) and vwap falls back to close (old: value/volume); the switched feed derives available_time the same way and omits traded_value. For rows whose real available_time or value differ the two reads are NOT identical. Needs a decision: add value and available_time columns to daily bars (persisted format change: previous-reader test in both directions against the hosted version read from /bff/version, and a change in daily_bars_reader.py _COLUMNS which belongs to a later task), or accept the derived values. Default setting stays run_files until decided.

G2 The survivorship attestation of the feed needs the all-market capture rows (collector.source_id, upstream_endpoint, trading_status), which are not part of daily bars. In daily_bars mode they are still read from normalized run files; after cleanup there are none and includes_delisted/includes_suspended become false (fail closed). The cleanup must not run on a window the feed still attests until the capture evidence has a store.

G3 daily_bars_reader.py exposes no symbol listing: callers need symbols to ask for. Added DailyBarsStore.symbol_stats (symbol column only) in daily_bars_store.py for the loader, the feed and depth. A reader-side listing would be the cleaner home (later task).

G4 A daily bar keeps the symbol as stored (symbol_canonical, e.g. 2330.TW); the old evaluator read keys by body.symbol. Callers passing bare codes to load_tw_price_daily_snapshot(symbols=...) in daily_bars mode get no match.

G5 The old evaluator read fails closed on conflicting duplicate prices; daily bars hold one row per key, so conflicts are resolved at backfill time by newest run (not by failing). Reported per date as duplicates; the conflicting-OHLC case is not separately counted.
G6 daily_bars_reader latency for 1 symbol x 2 years (above).
G7 Cleanup deletes whole run files per write-date partition; a file is refused unless every trade date it holds is verified, so one unverified date keeps the file.
